name: jl-knowledge-base-skill
description: Turn JL SDK requirements, schematics, UI documents, and shared experience into verified project changes in Codex.

defaultPrompt: Use $jl-sdk-engineer-core to implement and build this JL SDK requirement.

Review this JL SDK project and list the remaining hardware checks.
